edits.text: RECITALS. Plaintiff Harrow and Defendant Delmar wish to resolve the claims arising out of [identify the dispute, including any proceeding and case number] (the “Dispute”), on the terms below.
edits.name: Define the Dispute

edits.text: 1. PAYMENT. Defendant shall pay Plaintiff USD [TO BE AGREED] by wire transfer of immediately available funds to an account designated by Plaintiff in writing, no later than [PAYMENT DEADLINE TO BE AGREED]. The amount and payment deadline remain subject to client instructions and agreement in the final executed agreement.
edits.name: Reserve payment terms

edits.text: 2. RELEASE. Only upon Plaintiff’s receipt of the full settlement amount in cleared funds shall Plaintiff Harrow release Defendant Delmar from all claims and causes of action, whether known or unknown, arising out of the Dispute and based on acts or omissions occurring on or before the date of execution of this Agreement. No other person grants or receives a release under this clause. This release does not extend to rights or obligations under this Agreement, including the right to enforce it.
edits.name: Define and condition the release

edits.text: 3. CONFIDENTIALITY. The parties shall keep the terms of this settlement confidential, except that either party may disclose them as required by law, regulation, or court order, or to its legal and tax advisers who are subject to professional confidentiality obligations or agree to maintain confidentiality. Where legally permitted and reasonably practicable, a party required to make a disclosure shall give the other party advance written notice and limit disclosure to what is required.
edits.name: Add confidentiality exceptions
